entities.summary: KaVontae Lamon Turpin is an American professional football wide receiver and return specialist for the Dallas Cowboys of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the TCU Horned Frogs. Weighing just 154 pounds, Turpin is the lightest active NFL player.
